elements.evidence: The rendered clause still binds Licensee (our client): "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates who was directly involved in such services to leave his or her employment with that party." A mutual covenant still imposes a restriction on Customer, so the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer at all) is not achieved.

Operative text changed from "the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates" to "neither party will solicit any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates" — obligation now runs in both directions.

elements.element: The restriction covers only personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: "any person employed by the other party and/or its Affiliates who was directly involved in such services" — the prior all-employees scope ("any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates") is gone. Minor drafting note: "services" is used in lower case and is anchored to "the services under this Agreement" in the same sentence, so it is self-defining rather than a dangling defined term.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months after the person's involvement ends.
elements.evidence: "for the twelve (12) month period after the end of an individual's involvement in the services under this Agreement" replaces the three-year post-termination tail. The deterministic check "non-solicit duration ≤ 12 months" reports "number not found", but that is a regex artifact: the spelled-out "twelve (12) month period" is present in the operative text, so the substance satisfies the element. Residual (non-fatal) point: the retained lead-in "During the Term of this Agreement and" could, on a strict reading, keep the covenant alive for the balance of a long Term for someone whose involvement ended earlier; if we want it airtight, recast as "During the Term of this Agreement and for twelve (12) months after the end of an individual's involvement, whichever ends later/earlier as applicable."

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Retained definition: "'Solicit' means any affirmative recruitment specifically aimed at one or more individuals identified by name, title or affiliation, but shall not mean generally advertising job openings".

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches are excluded from the restriction.
elements.evidence: Retained: "or any activities that constitute follow-up to individuals who respond to job opening advertisements or who voluntarily initiate employment inquiries" — covers responsive and self-initiated (unsolicited) approaches.

elements.element: The restriction does not prohibit hiring.
elements.evidence: The operative verb remains solicitation only ("will not solicit ... to leave his or her employment"); no "employ or engage" or no-hire language appears anywhere in the clause.

reasons: Deviation classification is correct: the original bound only Licensee, covered every Licensor/Affiliate employee, and ran three years post-termination (past the 12-month fallback, though inside the 24-month walk-away).

All six fallback elements are met in the rendered operative language, so the redline is position-complete at the fallback level; the preferred position (no restriction on Customer) is deliberately not pursued and should be offered as the opening ask in negotiation if desired.
The failing deterministic check on duration is a false negative — "twelve (12) month period" is expressly in the operative text.

Minimality holds: only the temporal anchor, the party direction and the personnel scope were edited; the favourable existing "Solicit" definition with its advertising and voluntary-inquiry carve-outs is retained verbatim, and no survival tail, remedy, or other extraneous term was added.

Intent preserved: no undefined terms, no dangling cross-references, and no retained sentence contradicts the new period or scope. Optional tightening (not required for completeness): clarify that the lead-in "During the Term of this Agreement and" does not extend protection beyond 12 months after a given individual's involvement ends.
